name: Bathyal-Menhir
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, tectonic rift valleys emerge like the bones of the planet.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
Approach protocols for the smuggler cache are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
Business at the outpost is steady and deniable. Newcomers are welcome, watched, and priced accordingly.
